items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Well, he had a band out there. I stayed out there about four weeks with him

ctx.x: Yeah, everything on the paper, look on the paper, everything.

Well, I'll give you another little note. Uh, when I first started, I went out to home in Louisiana and played with Vincent Lopreston. There was an Italian out there, he had a band out there. Vincent, uh, Lopreston. Lopreston. Lopreston. Lopreston. Well, he had a band out there. I stayed out there about four weeks with him, waking at a club, you know?
Were they local fellows or from New Orleans?
